title: 28th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/28/1/2025).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 21/1/2025 to 24/1/2025).

Question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, Mohamed Ameen: the minister said the launch of MTCC taxis would not harm existing taxi drivers; if that was based on a study, share the study with the Majlis, and if not, explain why and how drivers would not be harmed.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Maldives Civil Aviation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé Central MP Abdulla Shazmee.
Report of the Finance Committee on its review of the Maldives Customs Service audit reports for 2012 to 2019.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, questioned the transport minister about MTCC taxis and existing drivers, continued the Civil Aviation Bill debate, and took up the Finance Committee's report on Customs audit reports from 2012 to 2019.
